processing_boundary.archive_and_mapping: matching is performed by object ID, asset ID and archive member before image extraction
processing_boundary.formal_and_diagnostic_training: train_formal.load_images decodes, converts RGB, resizes bilinearly and applies ImageNet normalization before the first epoch; batches then stack cached tensors
processing_boundary.historical_short_grid: train_resnet.VoteDataset decodes and transforms in __getitem__ with num_workers=0
processing_boundary.formal_and_extra_inference: the selected evaluation frame is decoded and normalized into a cache before batched forward passes
processing_boundary.memory: decoded image bytes and batch tensor estimates are available; peak process memory was not measured
processing_boundary.throughput: existing 128/224 benchmark times forward/loss/backward/optimizer step after materialising loader batches; it is not end-to-end formal fine-tuning throughput
processing_boundary.service_scope: static local archive experiment; no real-time cutout or inference service
